steps: Click the library option 'Soft impact' (or any option)
Click '▶ მოუსმინე' in the preview box
bugs.expected: the '▶ ისმის' playing badge stays inside the option card (CZABA visual consistency; the option is a 126 px wide card in a 144 px list)
bugs.contract: CZABA design rule (no overflow in the library list); no Live parity claim
bugs.actual: the badge row overflows the option: scrollWidth 139-152 px > clientWidth 126 px; '▶' sits past the card edge and 'ისმის' wraps to a second line clipped by the list edge
bugs.regression: no (not previously recorded; badge added before round 17)

steps: Open /studio-lab (fresh context), add 'CZABA hero' to the music lane at 0
Drag a range 4->8 s on the clip waveform
Press Z (zoom to range) -> about 137.7 px/s at 1440 (113.7 at 1280)
Press Z again on the same range (view does not change)
bugs.expected: X returns to the previous different view (40 px/s); a Z that does not change the view adds no history step
bugs.contract: SRW-10 R10-N2 says only 'X restores zoom+scroll exactly' (no written no-empty-step line); basis = precedent C-R108-01 (a duplicate zoom-history entry was ruled a Low bug, D-29z74) + Live 12 6.2 'the X key can be pressed multiple times to go back one step each time' (F)
bugs.actual: the second Z pushes a duplicate entry: the first X leaves the view at 137.7 px/s while the status says 'წინა ხედი აღდგა. X კიდევ ერთი ნაბიჯით აბრუნებს.'; only the second X returns to 40 px/s. Same at 1280x720
bugs.regression: no (related to deferred C-R108-01: duplicate zoom-history entry via held Enter on Zoom back/Fit)

recommendations.what: Live view/transport keys: Ctrl+Alt+B toggles the library, Ctrl+Alt+3 toggles the detail panel, O toggles the metronome (all three do nothing today)
recommendations.why: Live users toggle the Browser, Clip View and metronome by key; CZABA only has buttons
recommendations.manual: 42.22 'Hide/Show Browser Ctrl+Alt+B'; 42.x 'Hide/Show Clip View Ctrl+Alt+3'; 42.20 'Toggle Metronome O' https://www.ableton.com/en/live-manual/12/keyboard-shortcuts/

recommendations.what: Alt+= / Alt+- change the selected lane height (and Alt while dragging the split line resizes all lanes)
recommendations.why: keyboard height change exists in Live; CZABA only has the drag handle
recommendations.manual: 6.x track height 'Alt+ / Alt- shortcut keys', 'hold Alt while resizing a single track' https://www.ableton.com/en/live-manual/12/arrangement-view/

recommendations.what: U folds/unfolds the selected ordinary lane (today U only acts on groups and answers 'select a group')
recommendations.why: Live U = Fold/Unfold Selected Tracks; the status text is confusing on a normal lane (TRACK-FOLD-U signal)
recommendations.manual: 42.16 'Fold/Unfold Selected Tracks U or left and right arrow keys'; 6.x 'selected tracks can also be unfolded by pressing the U key'

recommendations.what: a key to focus the library search (Live Ctrl+F; in a browser Ctrl+F is find-in-page, so CZABA needs another key such as '/' or Ctrl+Shift+F)
recommendations.why: mouse-free search flow described in the manual
recommendations.manual: 5.2 Search Bar 'press Ctrl F … places a cursor in the search field' https://www.ableton.com/en/live-manual/12/working-with-the-browser/

recommendations.what: question for Saba: should a drop below the last lane create a new lane? (Live creates a new track; CZABA has a fixed lane set)
recommendations.why: Live parity vs the agreed simple lane set
recommendations.manual: 5.10 'Dragging … below Arrangement View tracks will create a new track' https://www.ableton.com/en/live-manual/12/working-with-the-browser/

recommendations.what: question (B-R107-ENTER-ON-BODY, open user question): Enter / double-click adds at the playhead on the active lane; confirm this is the wanted target
recommendations.why: Live text says 'onto whatever track is currently selected' and does not state the time position
recommendations.manual: 5.10 'double-clicking or pressing Enter on a … sample … will load the item onto whatever track is currently selected'

recommendations.what: add the missing time commands Paste Time (Ctrl+Shift+V), Duplicate Time (Ctrl+Shift+D) and Insert Silence (Ctrl+I); at least show a status line for the keys that do nothing today (Ctrl+Shift+C/V, Ctrl+I give no feedback)
recommendations.why: opening space for a new video shot on all lanes at once is a common film-scoring edit; today it needs a manual move of every clip
recommendations.manual: 6.11 Using the …Time Commands; 42.16 Copy/Paste/Duplicate Time, Insert Silence https://www.ableton.com/en/live-manual/12/arrangement-view/

recommendations.what: optional zoom-adaptive grid mode (the division follows the zoom) next to today's fixed division, toggled by a key (Live Ctrl+5; CZABA would need a plain key such as 5)
recommendations.why: when zoomed far out a fixed 0.1 s or 1/32 grid becomes too dense to use; when zoomed in a 10 s grid is too coarse
recommendations.manual: 6.10 'The grid can be set to be either zoom-adaptive or fixed'; 42.13 'Fixed/Zoom-Adaptive Grid Ctrl 5'

recommendations.what: question for Saba: allow Play (transport + metronome) in an empty project, so a user can set BPM and listen to the click before adding sound
recommendations.why: Live ticks as soon as Play is pressed; CZABA refuses Play with 'nothing to play'
recommendations.manual: Recording New Clips → Metronome 'will begin ticking when the Play button is pressed' https://www.ableton.com/en/live-manual/12/recording-new-clips/

recommendations.what: during playback, M adds the marker at the playhead even when a time range is still selected (today it goes to range.start, ROW-RANGE-M), and does not open the name field (today the field takes focus, so the next Space types a space into the name instead of stopping)
recommendations.why: marking hits while listening to the picture is a core scoring flow; today the user must press Enter/Escape before Space works, and a lingering range silently redirects the marker
recommendations.manual: 6.4 'The Set Locator button can be used to add locators … in real time during playback'; 'while transport is not running … at the insert marker location or at the start of the time selection' https://www.ableton.com/en/live-manual/12/arrangement-view/
